dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and continuous narrowing of the 2D body mass from the mid-section toward the visible posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey median tone across the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low frequency of faint, dark-pixel longitudinal streaks distributed along the central dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the darker pigmented streaks and the primary light-grey baseline canvas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple parallel, high-contrast dark longitudinal lines consistent with rake marks observed across the central and right-lateral dorsal planes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple healed, parallel longitudinal rake marks on the dorsal surface.
